name: Injoku no Kajitsu
source:
Main character is a graduating student. He is ordered to investigate project of a professor. However, when he arrives to the laboratory, surroundings begin to gradually turn weird. What's awaiting him in this wrong place during wrong time?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名即将毕业的学生，受命调查某位教授的研究项目。然而，当他抵达实验室后，周围的一切开始渐渐变得诡异。在这个错误的时间、错误的地点，究竟有什么正在等待着他？

[内容取自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
